_note: Cross-links between the Korean channel and the international channel (관리자 2026-11-13: '댓글이나 소개를 해외쪽으로도 연결 — 서로 연결되어야지'). Every video links three ways: (1) the same film in the other languages / the Korean original, (2) the other films of the series, (3) the site. xlinks.mjs audit checks every video in uploaded.json for these urls; apply inserts the missing lines after the last line with one-scroll-bible.com. Lines are '▶ <text>: <url>'. Translations: ours (back-translation review motion/reviews/xlinks-lines.md), never YouTube auto-translate.
